title: CG
description: config.ini [CG] section (CGConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

cg_no_overshooting.description: If true, prevent overshooting in CG.

cg_knock_out_max_move.description: If true, limit the maximum move in CG.

cg_line_search.description: If true, perform a line search in CG.

cg_line_converged.description: Convergence criterion for the line search in CG.

cg_max_iter_before_reset.description: Maximum number of iterations before reset in CG.

cg_max_iter_line_search.description: Maximum number of iterations for the line search in CG.
